state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place) is under way.** Stage 3 is done: `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md` names every goal in front of `goal-closeout`.

The `nvs-server` gap directory now has one record, `span-has-no-window`, which M10 owns. This goal owes nothing more there. The drain period now ends a response being written whether it is buffered or streamed (`crate::io`'s `ConnectionIo::closing`). A response that begins once the period is over, such as the drain's own `503`, gets one `write_idle_timeout` in total. `crate::io`'s two unit tests are the bound, and both fail without it. `a_whole_response_still_being_written_at_the_drain_periods_end_is_cut` in `serve.rs` is the outcome only, because `hyper`'s read probe during a parked write already ends `Phase::Write` early.

The `nvs-diagnostics`, `benches`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-db`, `nvs-ir`, `nvs-config` and `nvs-server` gap directories are closed for this goal. One `nvs-syntax` gap is left, `the-pipeline-bench-has-no-nested-twin`, which is a bench member in a different file set.

In `nvs-cli`, the other subcommands' `--help` text has not been swept and is still in the dense voice.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is many commits ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes (module doc of `tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts`). A person has to push, so no session can close it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest of the gaps across many crates. Smallest directories first: `website` (2), `vscode` (3), `nvs-cli` (4) and `nvs-host` (4). Stage 4 stops on `BLOCKED` only for "too large", as the goal's § *Stage 4* defines it. `bun nv import` is broken because the rule index it reads was deleted. Goal `ci-green`'s floor check stays red until Stage 6, as expected.

items.text: **A reload drains the connections the previous generation accepted** — gap `a-reload-closes-no-connection` (`rule:concurrency/a-drain-closes-a-connection-cleanly`: a reload closes connections the same way a stop does). `Process::reload` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/control.rs:602` begins no drain, and `Drain` at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/drain.rs:123` is one process-wide bit that also stops the accept loop. First decide whether a drain per published generation fits this goal, or is Stage 4's "too large": the gap record says what it changes. `a_reload_closes_no_connection_and_begins_no_drain` at `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs:751` is the case that changes with it.

backlog: `nvs-cli`: the other three gaps (`cache.rs`, `main.rs`, `serve.rs`) and the `--help` voice sweep — `bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout`.
`nvs-host`: four gaps in `group.rs`, `stack.rs` and `watchdog.rs`. The `group.rs` one needs a per-group stop that a safepoint poll can read.
`website` (2) and `vscode` (3): the smallest gap directories left.
`bun nv import` reads a deleted rule index — `tools/nv/cmd/import.ts`.
